hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Valves fully open or fully closed only; wall thickness checks on the most-used branch.

name: Feed port check valves
function: The check valve on each radial feed port of the discharge header that stops header pressure from back-driving a stopped pump.

tabs.overview: Flapper or dart type in the feed port; lets a pump be taken offline for a repair while the rest of the spread keeps pumping against the same header.
tabs.engineering: Rated with the header; erosion checked at the seat.
tabs.safety: A leaking check on an offline pump puts treating pressure on its fluid end; the pump's own discharge valve is closed before work.
tabs.evidence: Frac manifold missile patent (S31), electric fleet article (S37), fracturing design evolution article (S36), EIA regions (S38), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
